name: Chana Jor Chaat
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: ½ tsp each chaat masala and roasted cumin powder
2 tbsp roasted puffed rice (murmura) to top
steps: Warm the chickpeas for 1 minute in a pan, or use them at room temperature.
Mix with the onion, tomato, cucumber, coriander and chilli.
Add the lemon juice, chaat masala, cumin and black salt.
Toss well and top with puffed rice just before serving so it stays crisp.
note: A street-food favourite without fried toppings; the chickpeas supply most of the protein and fibre.
